note: The AffrescoUI Studio: the person's client for a running host. Layout, behaviour and the connection are all in this file, its texts in studio-strings.json (English, Spanish, French). Ask and direct changes on the left; on the right, tabs for the review queue, the history of main, the approval rules, the permissions (edits become changes to review), an inspector of the connected app and the agents. Below 900 pixels the two sides become panes. Cmd+Shift+P lists every command.

computed.evidence: {{state.evidence != null && computed.current != null && state.evidence.proposal == computed.current.id ? state.evidence : null}}
computed.diffs: {{computed.evidence == null ? [] : map(computed.evidence.texts, {type: 'diff', node: it.node, original: it.original, modified: it.modified, mode: 'split', language: it.language})}}
computed.tabs: {{concat([{id: 'review', label: t('tab.review', {n: length(state.proposals)}), closable: false}, {id: 'history', label: t('tab.history'), closable: false}, {id: 'rules', label: t('tab.rules', {n: length(state.grants)}), closable: false}, {id: 'permissions', label: t('tab.permissions'), closable: false}, {id: 'inspector', label: t('tab.inspector'), closable: false}], empty(state.coordination.peers) ? [] : [{id: 'agents', label: t('tab.agents', {n: length(state.coordination.peers)}), closable: false}])}}
computed.commandItems: {{map(filter(commands, it.enabled && it.name != 'showCommands'), {title: t('cmd.' + it.name), detail: t('cat.' + it.category) + (empty(it.keyLabel ?? '') ? '' : '  ·  ' + it.keyLabel), run: it.name})}}
computed.permValue: {{state.permSection == 'budgets' ? (computed.perm.budgets ?? []) : (state.permSection == 'data' ? (computed.perm.data ?? []) : (state.permSection == 'roles' ? {reviewers: computed.perm.reviewers ?? [], review: computed.perm.review ?? {}, roles: state.coordination.roles ?? {}} : {allow: computed.perm.allow ?? [], ask: computed.perm.ask ?? [], deny: computed.perm.deny ?? []}))}}
computed.permSections: {{map(['rules', 'budgets', 'data', 'roles'], {id: it, label: t('perm.section', {section: it}), closable: false})}}

applyPatch.note: A JSON Patch [...] or compact edits {"set": {...}}, as typed

then.data: {{merge({ type: 'revision', message: 'Direct change from the Studio' }, parseJson(state.patch))}}

notify.note: with: message. A toast in the corner for a few seconds

toggleInspector.note: The host's debug overlay: the panel under the pointer, frame statistics and an event trace

accept.note: with: always. Accepts the chosen proposal at the head that was reviewed. Never one's own: every path (button, key, palette, a run step) comes here, and the host refuses it too

askHistory.note: with: kind, revert or restore. Asks before changing main

host:evidence.to: {{merge({proposal: event.proposal, scale: event.scale}, {region: event.evidence.region, behaviour: event.evidence.behaviour, scenarios: event.evidence.scenarios, texts: event.evidence.texts ?? []})}}

logLine.note: with: kind, key, params. One activity line: its text now, and its key to translate it later

showTab.note: with: tab. The permissions page starts its draft from the current value

addConnection.note: Checks the address, then adds it to the known connections; the token stays in memory

removeConnection.note: with: id. The local one stays; removing the active one goes back to it

switchConnection.note: with: id. Connects the host channel to that address; one connection at a time

to.name: {{(empty(find(state.connections, it.id == id).name) ? t('conn.local') : find(state.connections, it.id == id).name)}}

params.name: {{(empty(find(state.connections, it.id == id).name) ? t('conn.local') : find(state.connections, it.id == id).name)}}

to.name: {{(empty(find(state.connections, it.id == id).name) ? t('conn.local') : find(state.connections, it.id == id).name)}}

params.name: {{(empty(find(state.connections, it.id == id).name) ? t('conn.local') : find(state.connections, it.id == id).name)}}

openChild.note: with: index. Goes into a child of the inspected node

pickPermSection.note: with: section. Shows a section; the draft starts as its current value

proposePermissions.note: The draft becomes a change waiting for a reviewer: the Studio never applies it, and no revision can change permissions

sendRequest.title: Send the request to the AI

inspectApp.title: Inspect the app under the pointer
